title: Baby Giraffe and the Sun
summary: Mama Giraffe works long days in the orange grove and sweats under the hot sun. Baby Giraffe wants to help her, and he has a plan: he will get rid of the sun!
pages: Baby Giraffe lives with Mama Giraffe in a little house.
He loves Mama Giraffe so much!
Mama Giraffe works in an orange grove.
The oranges are made into jam at Uncle Bear's bakery.
Mama Giraffe works very hard under the sun.
Baby Giraffe decides to help Mama Giraffe.
He gathers chairs and tables, tables and chairs. He piles them up, one on top of the other.
One chair, one table. One chair, one table. He starts to climb. High, higher, up he goes...
...until he reaches the sun! Amazing! The sun looks just like an orange.
Baby Giraffe has an idea. He opens his mouth wide, wide, wide.
Oh, no. What happened? Mama Giraffe and Uncle Bear can't see a thing.
Nobody can see anything! The owls are happy. Owls love the dark. But where is the light?
Baby Giraffe ate the sun.
His tummy is burning. He bursts into tears. Uncle Bear hears him crying and runs to him.
Baby Giraffe tells him everything.

Uncle Bear says, "Don't worry. I'll help you."
Together they bake a giant loaf of bread.
Uncle Bear tells Baby Giraffe to use the fire in his tummy to bake the bread. Baby Giraffe blows the fire out. Whoooo! Now he feels a little better.
The baked bread floats up high, higher. Where is it going?
Baby Giraffe is still sad. Mama Giraffe will still be hot. Uncle Bear gives him an umbrella as a present for Mama Giraffe. Hooray! Mama Giraffe won't be so hot anymore.
And what about the bread? If you look very closely, the sun looks just like a loaf of bread.
